title: Workspace Manifest
description: Canonical declarative form of a DevOS Workspace per DEVOS-SPEC-029. The manifest is complete, portable, version-controlled, and reviewable. It describes one Workspace and never executes. Secret values MUST NEVER appear in any field or encoding.

kind.description: Object kind; MUST be Workspace for a workspace manifest.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest schema contract version following DEVOS-SPEC-059.

project.description: The single Project owned by the Workspace per DEVOS-SPEC-021.

profiles.description: One or more Profiles, each embedding exactly one Environment per DEVOS-SPEC-022 and DEVOS-SPEC-029.

connections.description: Connections to external systems per DEVOS-SPEC-025; credentials as Secret references only.

providers.description: Replaceable capability providers per DEVOS-SPEC-024; credentials as Secret references only.

secrets.description: Secret references and metadata ONLY per DEVOS-SPEC-028; raw values are schema-invalid by construction.

workflows.description: Executable automations containing one or more Tasks each.

documentation.description: First-class documentation resources managed by the Workspace.

$comment: Ownership encoded in manifest instances MUST match DEVOS-SPEC-015: every element maps to a domain object of DEVOS-SPEC-011, no child has multiple owners, and references resolve within the manifest or are explicitly marked external.
